title: INQUIRE / SET TDQUEUE ENABLESTATUS: INQUIRE reports an intrapartition queue's type, enable and recovery status, SET ENABLED / DISABLED changes what INQUIRE reads back, QIDERR on an undefined queue, INVREQ RESP2 10 on a value ENABLESTATUS does not take

scenarios.summary: INQUIRE TDQUEUE of the defined queue HCQ1: TYPE INTRA (222), ENABLESTATUS ENABLED (23), RECOVSTATUS NOTRECOVABLE (30); INQUIRE of the undefined HCNQ: QIDERR, RESP2 1
SET TDQUEUE ENABLESTATUS(DISABLED) then INQUIRE reads DISABLED (24); SET ENABLED then INQUIRE reads ENABLED (23)
SET TDQUEUE ENABLESTATUS(ENABLED) of HCNQ, a queue the CSD does not define: QIDERR, RESP2 1
SET TDQUEUE ENABLESTATUS(OPEN), a value ENABLESTATUS does not take: INVREQ, RESP2 10, and the queue stays ENABLED
